content.thinking:
The issue: in `_build` for Range I append `((ord(node.low), ord(node.high)), accept)` — a tuple of (low,high) then accept. For Class: `tuple(node.items) + (accept,)` — that's (low,high,low,high,...,accept) — wrong! I intended `((tuple of ranges), accept)`. Let me fix: for Class: `self.trans[start].append((tuple(node.items), accept))`.

So trans[state] entries are (ranges_tuple, target). Then in step: `for ranges, target in self.trans[state]: for low,high in ranges`.

Fix the Class branch.

arguments.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 - <<'EOF'
path = 'src/eywa/regex.py'
src = open(path).read()
bad = "            self.trans[start].append(tuple(node.items) + (accept,))"
good = "            self.trans[start].append((tuple(node.items), accept))"
assert bad in src
open(path,'w').write(src.replace(bad, good))
print('ok')
EOF
python3 -c "
